notes:
The second operand is an absolute path to the  enabled  leaf of all areas, with no predicate binding to the interface's own area. Since XPath node-set = 'false'  is existential, the constraint is violated whenever the interface flag is  true  and any area anywhere has  enabled = 'false' .  The  description  states the intent is the interface's "OSPF area level capability," which argues for a relative path up to the containing area.

So correct /rt:routing/rt:control-plane-protocols/rt:control-plane-protocol/ospf:ospf/ospf:areas/ospf:area/  to  ../../../
